title: woodsia fragilis
intro: Woodsia fragilis, commonly known as the fragile woodsia or fragile fern, is a species of fern in the family Woodsiaceae. This plant is rich in various health benefits, including its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent, which can help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis, digestive issues, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Woodsia fragilis include its potential to lower blood sugar levels, inhibit cancer cell growth, and exhibit immunomodulatory and neuroprotective effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
